title: Production Software Engineering
description: Build maintainable software through tests, debugging, design, security, Git, and release engineering.
prerequisites: A working programming language and basic Git knowledge.
assessment: Complete a multi-file project with tests, review, release artifact, and incident note.

lessons.title: Workspace and Repository Discipline
lessons.objective: Create a reproducible project boundary and workflow.

lessons.title: Git, Branches, and Review
lessons.objective: Use branches, diffs, staging, and review before commit.

lessons.title: Tests and Acceptance Gates
lessons.objective: Turn requirements into tests that can fail honestly.

lessons.title: Debugging and Observability
lessons.objective: Trace a failure from symptom to verified fix.

lessons.title: Architecture and Boundaries
lessons.objective: Separate UI, domain, adapters, and side effects.

lessons.title: Security and Threat Modeling
lessons.objective: Identify trust boundaries, secrets, permissions, and abuse paths.

lessons.title: Performance and Resource Budgets
lessons.objective: Measure latency, memory, throughput, and failure behavior.

lessons.title: Release Engineering
lessons.objective: Build, checksum, document, and verify a release artifact.

lessons.title: Incident Response and Recovery
lessons.objective: Recover from a broken deployment without losing evidence.

lessons.title: Capstone: Production-Ready Service
lessons.objective: Deliver a reviewed, tested, observable, documented service.
